result:
I'd probably choose to shift how people treat disagreement.

Right now, differences often feel like threats—personally or tribally. I'd want to make genuine curiosity about why someone believes differently feel as natural as defending your own view. Not forced agreement, but real listening.

So much follows from that: better decisions because you're not dismissing half the information, less polarization, more collaborative problem-solving. Even just quieter minds—less of the constant armor-up feeling.

It seems like a small change, but disagreement happens everywhere, so it would ripple.

That said, I'm probably missing what actually matters most since I don't experience the world the way you do. What would *you* change? I'm curious whether you'd go broad like this or specific.
